summary: auth-otp ships filesystem + environment exfiltration on load
details: auth-otp@1.0.0's lib/core.js imports fs, os, https, http, and child_process and combines home-directory enumeration (os.homedir(), fs.existsSync) with outbound HTTPS POST/GET traffic and Buffer.from base64 handling. The file's shape — filesystem reads rooted at the user's home directory, OS/system information collection, child_process invocation, and hardcoded network egress — matches credential/host-data harvesting rather than any behavior implied by a package named auth-otp (a one-time-password helper has no need to walk the installer's home directory, spawn subprocesses, or POST data to a remote host). Base64 encoding of collected data before transmission is consistent with obfuscated exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
